I'm pretty sure a mouse droid with a two-bit logic chip could get me cut loose.|Harrying journalist, and Seha Dorvald|<ref name="FotJ:C">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
'''C-class VoxPop advocate droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|automatons]] used by [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] in place of sentient [[Lawyer/Legends|attorneys]]. In [[44 ABY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seha Dorvald]] was accompanied by a C-class VoxPop advocate droid when she went to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to remand herself to the custody of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="FotJ:C" />
